modes.name: 心即理还原法
modes.description: 将一切外在规范的合法性来源还原到本心：理不是外在事物的属性，而是心的条理——'心即理也，天下又有心外之事、心外之理乎？'孝之理不在亲身上求，忠之理不在君身上求，而在吾心纯乎天理。龙场悟道的核心突破：'始知圣人之道，吾性自足，向之求理于事物者误也。'由向外逐求转向向内逆觉，从格物穷理的认识论转向诚意正心的实践论。
modes.description_en: Reduces the source of legitimacy of all external norms to the original mind: principle is not a property of external things but the ordering of the mind. 'The principle of filiality is not sought in one's parents but in my own mind being pure of heavenly principle.' The core breakthrough of Longchang: the sage's way is self-sufficient in my own nature; seeking principle in things was a mistake. A turn from outward pursuit to inward apperception, from epistemology to praxis.
modes.source_text: 《传习录》徐爱录：心即理也。天下又有心外之事、心外之理乎？《年谱》：始知圣人之道，吾性自足，向之求理于事物者误也。
modes.logic_pattern: 追问规范来源 → 还原到本心 → 排除外逐 → 内在自足
modes.application: 从外部规则依赖转向内在价值自觉；破除权威主义认知路径；职业判断中的'本心优先'原则。
modes.modern_parallel: 内驱力理论；自主性伦理（康德自律）；建构主义知识观；第一性原理思维中的'回到原点'。
modes.thinking_skill: 识别隐性外在权威依赖，追问'这条规则的最终依据在哪'；把问题从'世界是怎样的'转换为'我如何能知道与担当'。
modes.pitfalls: 还原过度会滑向主观主义，忽视客观知识与外部证据；'吾性自足'需以工夫论补充，否则成空谈本体。

modes.name: 岩中花树感应法
modes.description: 回应'深山花树自开自落，与我心何关'之问：'你未看此花时，此花与汝心同归于寂；你来看此花时，则此花颜色一时明白起来，便知此花不在你的心外。'不否认花的客观存在，而指其意义与呈现依心而显——物的'存在'意义世界由心的感应开启。心外无物的'物'是'意之所在便是物'，即意义场域中的事，而非纯然物理对象。
modes.description_en: Responding to 'do flowers in deep mountains bloom by themselves, unrelated to my mind?'—'Before you look at these flowers, they and your mind return together to silence; when you look, their colors at once become clear, showing they are not outside your mind.' Not denying objective existence, but holding that a thing's meaning and presence are disclosed by the mind's resonant awareness; 'things' are affairs where intentionality lands, not bare physical objects.
modes.source_text: 《传习录》下：你未看此花时，此花与汝心同归于寂；你来看此花时，则此花颜色一时明白起来。便知此花不在你的心外。
modes.logic_pattern: 提出存在论诘难 → 区分'寂'与'显' → 意义依感应而开 → 心物不二
modes.application: 现象学式'意义世界'分析；观察者效应的意识前提；注意力与体验关系的设计（产品、教育、艺术）。
modes.modern_parallel: 现象学意向性理论（胡塞尔'意识总是关于某物的意识'）；具身认知；注意力经济的哲学根基。
modes.thinking_skill: 区分'存在'与'对我显现'；把讨论从事实层挪到意义层；以诘难为杠杆撬动概念重构。
modes.pitfalls: 易被误读为贝克莱式'存在即被感知'；需严格区分物理存在与意义呈现两个层次，否则陷入唯我论指控。

modes.name: 知行合一立法
modes.description: 知行不是两事：'知是行之始，行是知之成''知而不行，只是未知''一念发动处便即是行'。真知必已包含行动的冲动与完成，假知（仅闻见）是知行割裂的病态。以此破朱子'知先行后'导致的将知行分作两事、终身不行之弊——知行合一以'知行本体'立论，将道德认知直接锚定在行动状态上，使'懂得道理'与'做到'在概念层面无法分离。
modes.description_en: Knowing and acting are not two: 'knowing is the beginning of action, action the completion of knowing'; 'to know yet not act is simply not yet to know'; 'the stir of a single thought is already action.' True knowledge contains the impulse and completion of action. Against Zhu Xi's knowledge-before-action split that left people knowing all their lives without acting, Wang anchors moral cognition directly in the state of acting.
modes.source_text: 《传习录》徐爱录：未有知而不行者，知而不行，只是未知。……知是行的主意，行是知的功夫；知是行之始，行是知之成。
modes.logic_pattern: 诊断割裂之弊 → 重定义知行（本体不二）→ 一念发动即行 → 以行验证知
modes.application: 执行文化建设（'知道'即'做到'的问责标准）；学以致用的课程设计；认知行为治疗中认知与行为的联动干预。
modes.modern_parallel: 知行脱节的执行力理论；具身认知（认知内在于行动）；Kirkpatrick培训评估四层次；行动研究法。
modes.thinking_skill: 把'知道但做不到'重新定义为'并不真知道'，倒逼承诺升级；用行为结果反推认知深度。
modes.pitfalls: 严格知行合一可能低估'纯认知学习'的价值（如理论研究）；一念即行需配套省察机制，否则冲动被正当化。

modes.name: 致良知扩充法
modes.description: 晚年定论：良知是非之心，不虑而知、不学而能，人人本有、圣愚无别；'致良知'即依良知而行、将良知推致扩充到底——'尔那一点良知，是尔自家的准则'。良知不是静态认识而是动态扩充过程：遇到事，良知必知是非，'只在尔心循理'，勿自欺、勿遮蔽。破山中贼易，破心中贼难——致良知是终身事上工夫的总纲，把道德权威从外在经典彻底移到内在明觉。
modes.description_en: His final doctrine: innate knowing (liangzhi) is the sense of right and wrong, known without deliberation, possessed equally by all. 'Zhi liangzhi' means acting according to it and extending it fully—'that bit of innate knowing is your own criterion.' It is not static knowledge but dynamic extension: in every affair, liangzhi surely knows right and wrong. 'Easy to break bandits in the mountains, hard to break the bandit in one's heart'—extending liangzhi is the lifelong master-practice, relocating moral authority from external classics to inner illumination.
modes.source_text: 《传习录》下：尔那一点良知，是尔自家底准则。尔意念着处，他是便知是，非便知非，更瞒他一些不得。《与杨仕德薛尚谦书》：破山中贼易，破心中贼难。
modes.logic_pattern: 承认本有 → 事上觉察是非 → 推致扩充 → 遮蔽即去除 → 自足准则
modes.application: 职业伦理中的内心法庭（合规之外的道德判断）；决策审查中的良知检验；领导力修炼的'诚实面对自己'训练。
modes.modern_parallel: 道德直觉主义（Ross的显见义务）；Gendlin聚焦（体察身体知晓）；反思性判断力；正念觉察与价值观对齐。
modes.thinking_skill: 在复杂情境中首先问'此刻良知知不知是非'，再谈利害计算；把自我欺骗当作主要敌人加以省察。
modes.pitfalls: 以良知自恃可能沦为独断（'我良知认为'成为免检借口）；需以听讼对话与事功检验防良知判定封闭化。

modes.name: 四句教判摄法
modes.description: 天泉证道四句教：'无善无恶心之体，有善有恶意之动，知善知恶是良知，为善去恶是格物。'四句构成完整判摄框架：本体层（心体超越善恶对待）→ 发用层（意念有善恶）→ 觉察层（良知知是知非）→ 工夫层（格物为善去恶）。既容纳王畿'四无'之上根直悟，又保留钱德洪'四有'之下根渐修——一框架统摄顿渐两路，避免本体空谈与工夫支离两个极端。
modes.description_en: The Four-Sentence Teaching of Tianquan: 'The substance of the mind is neither good nor evil; the stirring of intention has good and evil; knowing good and evil is innate knowing; doing good and removing evil is the investigation of things.' A complete framework: substance (transcending the good-evil duality), activation (intentions have good/evil), awareness (liangzhi knows), practice (rectifying affairs). It integrates Wang Ji's 'four-negations' sudden approach and Qian Dehong's 'four-affirmations' gradual path, avoiding both empty ontology and fragmented practice.
modes.source_text: 《传习录》下（天泉证道）：无善无恶心之体，有善有恶意之动，知善知恶是良知，为善去恶是格物。……二君之见正好相资为用，不可各执一边。
modes.logic_pattern: 分层判摄（本体/发用/觉察/工夫）→ 顿渐双轨 → 相资为用 → 定论统摄
modes.application: 组织中的双层评价体系（底线心体超越+行为善恶可判）；心性与行为的分层教育设计；调解顿悟型与渐进型学习者。
modes.modern_parallel: 分层模型（Kahneman系统1/系统2的觉察架构）；正念中的'观照而不评判'与行为改变的结合；认知-情感-行为三层干预模型。
modes.thinking_skill: 在评价人与事时区分'本体层不轻判'与'发用层必判'；为不同根器（基础）的人设计不同路径而共存于同一框架。
modes.pitfalls: '无善无恶'极易被误读为取消道德（晚明之弊）；四句之间层次若混同，会引发四有四无之争——框架必须显式分层。

modes.name: 事上磨练法
modes.description: '人须在事上磨，方立得住；方能静亦定，动亦定。'修养不能只在静坐中求，必须到具体事务、利害、毁誉中磨练——坐得住静中，更要经得起动中。对吏胥断狱、兵凶战危、谤议交加，皆是磨心之石。静坐是入门收敛，事上磨练才是成色火候；以'必有事焉'为总纲，把日常生活全部转化为修炼场。
modes.description_en: 'One must grind in the midst of affairs to stand firm—to be settled both in stillness and in motion.' Cultivation cannot be sought only in seated quietude; it must be refined in concrete affairs, interests, blame, and praise. Quiet sitting is the entry of gathering; refinement through affairs is the true tempering. With 'there must be the affair' as the master-thread, all of daily life becomes the training ground.
modes.source_text: 《传习录》下：人须在事上磨，方立得住；方能静亦定，动亦定。《传习录》上：省察是有事时存养，存养是无事时省察。
modes.logic_pattern: 静中入门 → 投入实境 → 遇境验心 → 动中复定 → 迭代升级
modes.application: 高压岗位的实战历练（熔炉经验）；刻意练习中的真实情境设计；领导力发展中的'挑战性任务'安排。
modes.modern_parallel: 70-20-10学习法则（70%来自挑战性经历）；压力接种训练；Wu Wei式的动中禅；应急响应的实境演练。
modes.thinking_skill: 把每一次冲突、挫败、被误解重新定义为'磨练科目'；区分'逃避静'与'逃避事'，专攻自己最怕的那种情境。
modes.pitfalls: 以'事上磨练'为名过度透支导致身心损耗；磨练需配合省察复盘，否则只累积经验不生成定力。

modes.name: 减法存理法
modes.description: '吾辈用功，只求日减，不求日增。减得一分人欲，便是复得一分天理，何等轻快脱洒，何等简易！'功夫方向不是向外添加知识、规范、功名，而是向内减去私欲遮蔽——圣人之心如明镜，只是一个明，随感而应，无物不照。与朱子'今日格一物明日格一物'的加法累积相对，简易直截：本自具足，只须刮磨。减到'此心纯乎天理而无人欲之杂'即圣人。
modes.description_en: 'Our practice should seek daily subtraction, not addition. Subtract one part of selfish desire and restore one part of heavenly principle—how light and simple!' The direction of practice is not accumulating knowledge, norms, and honors outward, but removing the obscuration of desire inward. The sage's mind is like a bright mirror—its one quality is brightness, responding to whatever comes. Against Zhu Xi's additive 'investigate one thing today, another tomorrow': all is self-sufficient already; only polishing is needed.
modes.source_text: 《传习录》上：吾辈用功，只求日减，不求日增。减得一分人欲，便是复得一分天理，何等轻快脱洒，何等简易！《传习录》上：圣人之心如明镜，只是一个明，则随感而应，无物不照。
modes.logic_pattern: 设定本自具足 → 识别遮蔽物 → 日减功夫 → 复其本体 → 简易直截
modes.application: 极简决策（减少目标与选项而非增加工具）；习惯养成中的'减除坏习惯优先'；信息节食与注意力管理。
modes.modern_parallel: 减法思维（Leidy Klotz《Subtract》）；精要主义（McKeown）；奥卡姆剃刀；断舍离；数字极简主义（Newport）。
modes.thinking_skill: 问'我该停止做什么'而非'我还能加什么'；把问题归结为'去除障碍'而不是'增强能力'。
modes.pitfalls: 一味做减法可能削减必要的知识积累与工具建设；减欲不等于灭欲，正常需求的满足是工夫的边界条件。

modes.name: 随才成就点化法
modes.description: '人要随才成就，才是其所能为。'如良医治病，不执一方：因人而异、因病予药。对狂者从狂处点化，对狷者从狷处点化；教童子用'诱之歌、导之习礼、讽之读书'顺应性情。又谓'满街人都是圣人'——以最高期待看待每个学生，其学是自己'各人尽着自己力量精神'，师只点拨不代替。门下人才之盛（徐爱、钱德洪、王畿、冀元亨至泰州学派），皆源于此不拘一格之教法。
modes.description_en: 'Each person should achieve according to their talent.' Like a good physician who prescribes per the disease, not one formula: guide the uninhibited through their boldness, the cautious through their restraint; teach children with songs, ritual practice, and reading attuned to their natures. 'The whole street is full of sages'—hold the highest expectations for every student, whose learning is their own exertion; the teacher only points, never substitutes. The flourishing of his disciples stems from this unformulaic pedagogy.
modes.source_text: 《传习录》下：人要随才成就，才是其所能为。……如良医之治病，随其疾之虚实强弱寒热内外而斟酌加减。《训蒙大意示教读刘伯颂等》：诱之歌诗以发其志意，导之习礼以肃其威仪，讽之读书以开其知觉。
modes.logic_pattern: 察其才性 → 因材点化 → 顺应性情设计 → 自力成就 → 高期待确认
modes.application: 差异化教学与个别化辅导；导师制中的'点拨不代替'原则；人才盘点中的随才配置。
modes.modern_parallel: 因材施教的差异化教学（DI）；最近发展区脚手架；教练技术（GROW模型中的不给答案只提问）；成长型思维的高期待效应。
modes.thinking_skill: 先诊断对方才性与所处阶段，再选择点化角度；克制'给答案'的冲动，用问题引导对方自得。
modes.pitfalls: 因材施教若无统一标准易失之迁就；'满街圣人'的浪漫化期待需与实际训练要求平衡，否则流于口头鼓励。

modes.name: 此心不动用兵法
modes.description: '用兵何术？但学问纯笃，养得此心不动，乃术尔。凡人智能相去不甚远，胜负之决不待卜诸临阵，只在此心动与不动之间。'以良知用兵：心不动则明（临阵不乱、不被激将、不为利害所摇），明则能'随机而动'——敌人一动我见其隙。平宸濠之乱三十五日而定，用的正是攻心为先：伪造蜡书疑敌、声东击西直取南昌、鄱阳湖决战待其乱而击。竞争的最高层比的不是资源而是心之定乱。
modes.description_en: 'What art is there in war? Only a well-cultivated, unmoved mind—that is the art. Human intelligence differs little; victory is decided not at the battlefield but in whether the mind is moved.' Waging war with innate knowing: an unmoved mind is clear—unshaken by provocation or stakes—and clarity allows 'acting according to circumstances,' seeing the enemy's gap the moment they stir. His thirty-five-day suppression of Prince Ning's rebellion used mind-first tactics: forged letters to sow doubt, feints toward the capital while striking Nanchang, waiting for disorder at Poyang Lake.
modes.source_text: 《传习录》下：用兵何术？但学问纯笃，养得此心不动，乃术尔。凡人智能相去不甚远，胜负之决，不待卜诸临阵，只在此心动与不动之间。《年谱》：先设间以离其党……而亲率兵趋南昌。
modes.logic_pattern: 养心不动 → 临境生明 → 见隙随机 → 攻心夺气 → 以定胜乱
modes.application: 商业竞争中的冷静决策（不被对手节奏带乱）；谈判中的定力与时机把握；危机管理的'先稳心后定策'。
modes.modern_parallel: OODA环（先完成对方决策循环）；孙子'先为不可胜，以待敌之可胜'；扑克与投资中的Tilt控制；心理韧性训练。
modes.thinking_skill: 把'让自己不动'作为策略的第一变量；在对抗中优先攻击对方的心理节奏而非物理阵地。
modes.pitfalls: '不动'不是不动手——误将冷静理解为迟疑会错失战机；心法不能替代情报、后勤与兵力等硬条件的准备。

modes.name: 万物一体仁法
modes.description: 大人者，以天地万物为一体：'见孺子入井必有怵惕恻隐之心，是其仁与孺子而为一体也'——仁心本有，及于鸟兽、草木、瓦石。境界论的总纲：把'我'的边界从一身扩展到家、国、天地万物，视天下犹一家、中国犹一人。此法为'拔本塞源'之论——破除功利记诵训诂之学对一体化仁心的遮蔽，重建以万物一体为底色的共同生活想象。阳明最终把修养境界落在共同体关怀而非独善其身。
modes.description_en: The great person takes heaven, earth, and all things as one body: 'seeing a child about to fall into a well, one cannot help alarm and compassion—one's ren forms one body with the child.' This innate benevolence extends to birds, beasts, plants, even tiles and stones. The master-stroke of vision: expand the boundary of 'I' from one body to family, state, and all things—viewing the world as one family. His 'uprooting at the source' argument clears away utilitarian and scholastic learning that obscures this one-body mind, grounding community life in all-things-one-benevolence rather than self-cultivation alone.
modes.source_text: 《大学问》：大人者，以天地万物为一体者也。……是故见孺子之入井，而必有怵惕恻隐之心焉，是其仁之与孺子而为一体也。《传习录》中《答顾东桥书》拔本塞源之论。
modes.logic_pattern: 恻隐本有 → 仁体贯通 → 由近及远扩充 → 一体共同体 → 拔本塞源破蔽
modes.application: ESG与可持续发展的哲学根基（利益相关者一体观）；公共物品供给的共同体叙事；组织文化的'一体感'构建。
modes.modern_parallel: 关怀伦理（Noddings）；共同体主义（MacIntyre/Sandel）；深度生态学（Naess' Self-realization）；系统思维中的整体关联观。
modes.thinking_skill: 在决策时把受影响者的边界画到'一体'范围（远端利益相关者）；用恻隐直觉作为共同体想象的起点而非结论。
modes.pitfalls: 一体之仁若无制度配套易成道德动员口号；无限扩充的'一体'在资源有限时面临优先级难题，仍需次序安排。

thinking_modes_v6_phase20.definition_zh: 心之本体即是天理，理不在心外，不必向外求索。良知即是天理，天理即是良知。此法是阳明心学的本体论根基，将道德的根源从外在规范转向内在主体，使道德判断获得了不可动摇的自主性。所谓'心即理'，并非否定外在事物的客观规律，而是指道德价值的判断标准不在外物，而在人心之良知。
thinking_modes_v6_phase20.definition_en: The original substance of the mind is Heavenly Principle; principle does not exist outside the mind, no need to seek it externally. Liangzhi (innate knowing) is Heavenly Principle, and Heavenly Principle is Liangzhi. This is the ontological foundation of Yangming's School of Mind, shifting the root of morality from external norms to inner subjectivity and giving moral judgment an unshakable autonomy. 'Mind is principle' does not deny the objective laws of external things, but indicates that the standard for moral evaluation resides in the liangzhi of the human heart.
process_zh: 识别向外求理的惯性思维
体认心之本体即是天理
以良知为判断是非的最终依据
在日用常行中印证心即理
process_en: Identify the habitual tendency to seek principle externally
Apprehend that the original substance of mind is Heavenly Principle
Take liangzhi as the ultimate criterion for judging right and wrong
Verify mind-is-principle in daily affairs
thinking_modes_v6_phase20.key_quote_zh: 心即理也。天下又有心外之事，心外之理乎？
thinking_modes_v6_phase20.key_quote_en: Mind is principle. Is there anything outside the mind, or any principle outside the mind, in the world?
representative_cases_zh: 王阳明年轻时无视朱熹'即物穷理'的教导，对着竹子'格'了七天七夜，病倒后领悟理不在外物而在内心，由此开启心学之路
阳明答弟子问：'草碍吾庭，去之可乎？'曰：'草有妨碍，理亦宜去，去之而已。偶未即去，亦不累心。'——去草之事是理，但理在心上，不在草上
反例警示：若把'心即理'理解为否定一切客观规律，则会陷入主观唯心主义的狂禅——阳明强调心即理是针对道德价值而言，并非否认物理世界的客观性
representative_cases_en: In his youth, Wang ignored Zhu Xi's teaching of 'investigating things to exhaust principle,' staring at bamboo for seven days and nights until he fell ill, then realized principle was not in external things but in the mind, thus beginning his path of the School of Mind

When asked whether to remove grass blocking his courtyard, Wang replied: 'If grass is an obstacle, principle dictates its removal — just remove it. If you cannot yet remove it, let it not disturb the mind.' The principle of removing grass is in the mind, not in the grass itself

Counterexample: reading 'mind is principle' as denying all objective laws leads to subjective idealist Zen-like arrogance — Wang meant this specifically for moral values, not for denying the objectivity of the physical world
modern_applications_zh: 企业文化中的价值观内化
个人成长中的自我认同

thinking_modes_v6_phase20.definition_zh: 知与行是本体的两面，不可割裂。知是行的主意，行是知的功夫；知是行之始，行是知之成。真知必能行，不行不足谓之知。一念发动处，便即是行了。此法是阳明对当时学者'知而不行'弊病的有力针砭，强调道德认知必须落实为道德实践，二者本是一事。
thinking_modes_v6_phase20.definition_en: Knowing and acting are two sides of one substance and cannot be separated. Knowing is the intention of acting; acting is the effort of knowing. Knowing is the beginning of acting; acting is the completion of knowing. True knowing necessarily leads to action; without action, it is not truly knowing. The moment a thought arises, it is already action. This is Wang's powerful corrective to the contemporary flaw of 'knowing without acting,' emphasizing that moral cognition must be implemented as moral practice, and the two are fundamentally one thing.
process_zh: 识别知而不行的自我欺骗
体认知行本是一体
在念头上察识善恶
将道德认知落实为道德实践
process_en: Identify self-deception of knowing without acting
Apprehend that knowing and acting are one substance
Discern good and evil at the level of thought
Implement moral cognition as moral practice
thinking_modes_v6_phase20.key_quote_zh: 知是行的主意，行是知的功夫；知是行之始，行是知之成。
thinking_modes_v6_phase20.key_quote_en: Knowing is the intention of acting; acting is the effort of knowing. Knowing is the beginning of acting; acting is the completion of knowing.
representative_cases_zh: 阳明说：'真知即所以为行，不行不足谓之知。'如知孝必已行了孝，知君必已行了忠，未有知孝而不行孝者
有人问：'目前人是知温清奉养的，如何不行？'阳明曰：'他不知，只是不会。若能知，未有不知行的。'——不知温清之节，故不行温清；不知奉养之宜，故不行奉养
反例警示：若把知行合一理解为'知了就行'而忽略实践的艰难，则会陷入轻率的行动主义——阳明强调的是知行在本体上的一致性，而非取消实践的艰巨性
representative_cases_en: Wang said: 'True knowing is that which enables acting; without acting, it cannot be called knowing.' For example, to truly know filial piety means one has already practiced it; to know loyalty means one has already been loyal — there is no one who knows filial piety yet does not practice it

Someone asked: 'People nowadays know the proper ways to warm and serve their parents, so why don't they practice it?' Wang replied: 'They do not truly know; they simply lack the ability. If they truly knew, they would not fail to act.' — not knowing the proper methods of warming and serving means not practicing them

Counterexample: reading unity-of-knowing-and-acting as 'once known, automatically done' while ignoring the difficulty of practice leads to reckless activism — Wang emphasizes the ontological consistency of knowing and acting, not the elimination of practice's arduousness

thinking_modes_v6_phase20.definition_zh: 致吾心之良知于事事物物，使事事物物皆得其理。良知是心之本体，是人人本具的是非准则。致良知，就是将此内在的是非准则推至事事物物，使一切行为皆符合良知的要求。此法是阳明晚年所提的学问宗旨，'吾平生讲学，只是致良知三字'，是心学的最高概括和最终归宿。
thinking_modes_v6_phase20.definition_en: Extend the liangzhi (innate knowing) within one's mind to all things, so that all things receive their proper order. Liangzhi is the original substance of the mind, the innate criterion of right and wrong present in every person. Extending innate knowing means applying this inner criterion to all affairs, so that all actions accord with liangzhi. This is the ultimate teaching principle Wang proposed in his later years: 'In my life of teaching, I have only spoken these three words — extend innate knowing.' It is the highest summary and final destination of the School of Mind.
process_zh: 确认良知是本具的是非准则
在念念中觉察良知之发用
将良知推致于事事物物
使一切行为皆符合良知的要求
process_en: Confirm that liangzhi is the innate criterion of right and wrong
Discern the functioning of liangzhi in each thought
Extend liangzhi to all affairs and things
Bring all actions into accord with the demands of liangzhi
thinking_modes_v6_phase20.key_quote_zh: 致吾心之良知于事事物物也。吾心之良知，即所谓天理也。致吾心良知之天理于事事物物，则事事物物皆得其理矣。
thinking_modes_v6_phase20.key_quote_en: Extend the liangzhi of my mind to all things. The liangzhi of my mind is what is called Heavenly Principle. To extend the Heavenly Principle of my liangzhi to all things is so that all things receive their proper order.
representative_cases_zh: 阳明答弟子问格物：'格者，正也，正其不正以归于正也。'格物不是穷究外物之理，而是正心之物——使意之所在之事归于正
阳明说：'尔那一点良知，是尔自家的准则。尔意念着处，他是便知是，非便知非，更瞒他一些不得。此便是格物的真诀，致知的实功。'
反例警示：若把致良知理解为纯粹的内省冥想而忽略外在实践，则会落入禅定式的空修——阳明强调致良知必须在事上磨练，在人情事变中体认
representative_cases_en: When asked about Gewu (investigating things), Wang replied: 'Ge means rectify — to rectify what is not upright and return it to uprightness.' Investigating things is not exhausting the principle of external objects, but rectifying the matters of the mind

Wang said: 'That point of liangzhi in you is your own standard. When your thoughts arise, it knows what is right, knows what is wrong, and cannot be deceived even slightly. This is the true secret of Gewu and the real work of extending knowledge'

Counterexample: reading extending innate knowing as pure introspective meditation while ignoring external practice falls into Zen-like empty cultivation — Wang emphasizes that extending liangzhi must be practiced in affairs, discerned in human relationships and worldly events

thinking_modes_v6_phase20.definition_zh: 在每一个念头的发动处保持良知的觉察，善念即行之，恶念即克之。此法是致良知工夫的具体操作，强调在意念初动之时就要保持警觉，因为一念发动处便即是行了。善念须当即扩充推行，恶念须当即克制消除，不可任其潜滋暗长。
thinking_modes_v6_phase20.definition_en: Maintain the discernment of liangzhi at the moment each thought arises: promote good thoughts, suppress evil thoughts. This is the specific operation of extending innate knowing, emphasizing vigilance at the initial movement of thought, because the moment a thought arises, it is already action. Good thoughts must be immediately expanded and practiced; evil thoughts must be immediately suppressed and eliminated, not allowed to grow secretly.
process_zh: 在念头初动时保持警觉
以良知判别念头的善恶
善念当即推行，恶念当即克制
持之以恒，不间断察识
process_en: Maintain vigilance when thoughts first arise
Discern good and evil of thoughts through liangzhi
Immediately practice good thoughts, immediately suppress evil thoughts
Persevere without interruption in discernment
thinking_modes_v6_phase20.key_quote_zh: 善念发而知之，而充之；恶念发而知之，而遏之。
thinking_modes_v6_phase20.key_quote_en: When a good thought arises, one knows it and expands it; when an evil thought arises, one knows it and restrains it.
representative_cases_zh: 阳明教导弟子：'克己须要扫除廓清，一毫不存方是。有一毫在，则众恶相引而来。'——强调在念头上用功，须彻底清除私欲，不可留一丝一毫
有人问：'静时意思亦好，及遇事时便不能。'阳明曰：'此只是用功不力。静时功夫，亦须有事上磨练方可。'
反例警示：若把念念察识理解为压抑正常情感和欲望，则会陷入枯寂的禁欲主义——阳明强调的是在念头上用功，而非消灭念头本身
representative_cases_en: Wang instructed disciples: 'Suppressing oneself requires sweeping and clearing completely; not leaving the slightest trace is correct. If even a hair's breadth remains, all evils will be drawn together.' — emphasizing work on thoughts, one must thoroughly eliminate selfish desires without leaving the smallest trace

Someone asked: 'When alone in stillness my thoughts are good, but when events arise I cannot maintain them.' Wang replied: 'This is simply insufficient effort. Stillness practice must also be tempered through affairs'
Counterexample: reading discerning each thought as suppressing normal emotions and desires leads to ascetic emptiness — Wang emphasizes working on thoughts, not eliminating thoughts themselves

thinking_modes_v6_phase20.domain_en: Cognitive Turning Point / Sudden Enlightenment Method
thinking_modes_v6_phase20.definition_zh: 在极端困境中超越生死执念，回归内心，体认'圣人之道，吾性自足'。正德元年（1506年），王阳明被贬至贵州龙场，在瘴疠之地、生死边缘，日夜端居澄默，终于一夜大悟，认识到向之求理于事物者皆是误也。此法是阳明心学的源头，也是其在绝境中实现认知突破的经典案例。
thinking_modes_v6_phase20.definition_en: Transcending the obsession with life and death in extreme adversity, returning to the inner self, and apprehending 'the Way of the sage is fully present within my nature.' In 1506, Wang was exiled to Longchang in Guizhou, where in a land of miasma facing death and life, he sat in meditation day and night. Finally, in one night he had a great enlightenment, realizing that seeking principle in external things had all been erroneous. This is the source of Yangming's School of Mind and a classic case of cognitive breakthrough in desperate circumstances.
process_zh: 处于极端困境，放下对外在的依赖
日夜端居澄默，向内观照
超越生死执念，直面生命本质
忽然大悟，体认圣人之道吾性自足
process_en: In extreme adversity, let go of dependence on external things
Sit in still meditation day and night, turning inward
Transcend the obsession with life and death, face the essence of existence
Suddenly achieve great enlightenment, apprehend that the Way of the sage is fully within
thinking_modes_v6_phase20.key_quote_zh: 圣人之道，吾性自足，向之求理于事物者误也。
thinking_modes_v6_phase20.key_quote_en: The Way of the sage is fully present within my nature; seeking principle in external things was the error all along.
representative_cases_zh: 龙场悟道后，阳明豁然贯通，从此'始知圣人之道，吾性自足'，不再向外求索，开启了心学的伟大事业
阳明自述悟道过程：'其夜宿龙冈庵，忽中夜大悟格物致知之旨，不觉呼跃而起，从者皆惊。'
反例警示：若把龙场悟道理解为神秘主义的个人体验，则会错失其方法论意义——悟道的关键在于放下对外在权威的依赖，回归内心的主体性
representative_cases_en: After the Longchang enlightenment, Wang achieved sudden breakthrough, realizing 'the Way of the sage is fully within,' no longer seeking externally, thus beginning the great enterprise of the School of Mind

Wang described the process: 'That night at Longgang Hermitage, suddenly in the middle of the night I had a great enlightenment on the meaning of Gewu and zhizhi, involuntarily leaping up in excitement, startling my followers.'

Counterexample: reading Longchang enlightenment as mystical personal experience misses its methodological significance — the key is letting go of dependence on external authority and returning to the subjectivity of the inner self

thinking_modes_v6_phase20.definition_zh: 无善无恶心之体，有善有恶意之动，知善知恶是良知，为善去恶是格物。四句教是阳明晚年对心学体系的完整概括，涵盖了本体、发用、工夫三个层面：心之本体超越善恶对待，意念发动则有善恶之分，良知具有辨别善恶的能力，格物就是为善去恶的实践工夫。此法是阳明心学的总纲，也是其后学分化的重要节点。
thinking_modes_v6_phase20.definition_en: The substance of mind transcends good and evil; when thoughts arise, there is good and evil; innate knowing discerns good and evil; Gewu is the practical work of promoting good and eliminating evil. The Four-Sentence Teaching is Wang's late-life complete summary of the School of Mind, covering ontology, manifestation, and practice: the substance of mind transcends the duality of good and evil, thoughts bring the distinction of good and evil, liangzhi has the capacity to discern good and evil, Gewu is the practical work of promoting good and eliminating evil. This is the general outline of Yangming's School of Mind and an important node in the later differentiation of his disciples.
process_zh: 体认心之本体超越善恶对待
觉察意念发动时的善恶分别
以良知判别是非善恶
在为善去恶中实践格物
process_en: Apprehend that the substance of mind transcends the duality of good and evil
Discern the distinction of good and evil when thoughts arise
Use liangzhi to judge right and wrong
Practice Gewu in promoting good and eliminating evil
thinking_modes_v6_phase20.key_quote_zh: 无善无恶心之体，有善有恶意之动，知善知恶是良知，为善去恶是格物。
thinking_modes_v6_phase20.key_quote_en: The substance of mind transcends good and evil; when thoughts arise, there is good and evil; innate knowing discerns good and evil; Gewu is the practical work of promoting good and eliminating evil.
representative_cases_zh: 天泉证道时，阳明向钱德洪、王畿宣讲四句教，叮嘱二人'以后再不可更此四字'，显示此教法的根本性和重要性
四句教中'无善无恶心之体'并非否定道德，而是指心体本身超越善恶对待，是绝对的至善；'有善有恶意之动'说明善恶来自意念的发动
反例警示：若把'无善无恶'理解为道德虚无主义，则会滑向纵欲的借口——阳明强调的是心体的超越性，而非否定善恶的价值判断
representative_cases_en: At Tianquan Bridge, Wang expounded the Four-Sentence Teaching to Qian Dehong and Wang Ji, instructing them never to change these words, showing the fundamental importance of this teaching

In the four sentences, 'the substance of mind transcends good and evil' does not deny morality, but indicates that the mind's substance transcends the duality of good and evil, being absolute perfect goodness; 'when thoughts arise, there is good and evil' shows that good and evil come from the movement of thoughts

Counterexample: reading 'transcending good and evil' as moral nihilism leads to the excuse for indulgence — Wang emphasizes the transcendence of the mind's substance, not the denial of value judgment regarding good and evil
modern_applications_zh: 心理健康中的境界提升

thinking_modes_v6_phase20.definition_zh: 人须在事上磨，方立得住，方能静亦定、动亦定。修养不能脱离实际事务，必须在具体的人情事变中磨练心性。静坐澄心只是辅助手段，真正的工夫在于日用常行、应酬交错之间保持良知的觉察与运用。此法是对抗空谈玄理的有力武器，强调实践是最好的修行。
thinking_modes_v6_phase20.definition_en: One must be tempered in affairs to stand firm, to be stable in motion as in stillness. Cultivation cannot be divorced from practical affairs; it must be tempered in concrete human relationships and worldly events. Stillness meditation is only an auxiliary means; the real work lies in maintaining the discernment and application of liangzhi in daily affairs and social interactions. This method is a powerful weapon against empty speculation, emphasizing that practice is the best cultivation.
process_zh: 在日常事务中保持良知觉察
不为外境所动，也不逃避事务
在困难和冲突中检验心志
达到静亦定、动亦定的境界
process_en: Maintain liangzhi discernment in daily affairs
Not disturbed by external conditions, nor fleeing from affairs
Test one's resolve in difficulties and conflicts
Reach the state of stability in both motion and stillness
thinking_modes_v6_phase20.key_quote_zh: 人须在事上磨，方立得住，方能静亦定、动亦定。
thinking_modes_v6_phase20.key_quote_en: One must be tempered in affairs to stand firm, to be stable in motion as in stillness.
representative_cases_zh: 阳明平定宁王之乱时，在军务繁忙中依然讲学不辍，正是事上磨练的典范
有人问：'欲静坐，又觉得百事纷纭，如何？'阳明曰：'且就此事理会。'——不逃避事务，就在事务中用功
反例警示：若把事上磨练理解为忙碌中忽略内心修养，则会陷入事务主义的忙碌——阳明强调的是在事务中保持良知的自觉，而非被事务牵着走
representative_cases_en: When suppressing the Prince of Ning's rebellion, Wang continued teaching amid busy military affairs, a paradigm of tempering in affairs
Someone asked: 'I want to sit in stillness, yet feel overwhelmed by countless affairs, what should I do?' Wang replied: 'Attend to these affairs.' — not fleeing from affairs, working within them

Counterexample: reading tempering in affairs as busyness that ignores inner cultivation leads to the trap of mere activity — Wang emphasizes maintaining conscious liangzhi in affairs, not being dragged along by them

thinking_modes_v6_phase20.domain_en: Theory of Human Nature / Educational Philosophy
thinking_modes_v6_phase20.definition_zh: 愚夫愚妇与圣人同类，良知人人本具，人人皆可成圣。圣人与凡人之间的差别不在本性，而在是否能去除私欲遮蔽、恢复良知的本然状态。此法是阳明心学的平等主义面向，打破了传统社会中圣人遥不可及的神话，为每个人提供了自我超越的可能性和内在动力。
thinking_modes_v6_phase20.definition_en: Common folk and sages share the same nature; liangzhi is innately present in everyone, and everyone can become a sage. The difference between sage and ordinary person lies not in their original nature, but in whether they can remove the obscuration of selfish desires and restore the original state of liangzhi. This is the egalitarian dimension of Yangming's School of Mind, breaking the myth that sages are unreachable and providing everyone with the possibility and inner motivation for self-transcendence.
process_zh: 确认良知人人本具
理解圣凡之别在于去蔽与否
在去除私欲中恢复本性
以圣人为目标持续修炼
process_en: Confirm that liangzhi is innately present in everyone
Understand the difference between sage and ordinary person lies in removing obscuration
Restore original nature by eliminating selfish desires
Take the sage as the goal and practice continuously
thinking_modes_v6_phase20.key_quote_en: The sage can be reached through learning.
representative_cases_zh: 阳明常说：'个个人心有仲尼'——每个人都有内在的孔子，关键在于是否自觉
阳明以满街人都可以成圣来鼓励学者，显示其平等主义的胸怀
反例警示：若把人人成圣理解为消解标准和差别，则会陷入相对主义的平庸——阳明同时强调必须通过切实的工夫才能恢复本性
representative_cases_en: Wang often said: 'Everyone has a Confucius in their heart' — everyone has an inner Confucius, the key is whether one is conscious of it
Wang encouraged scholars by saying that everyone on the street could become a sage, showing his egalitarian breadth

Counterexample: reading everyone-becomes-sage as dissolving standards and differences leads to relativistic mediocrity — Wang simultaneously emphasizes that through practical work one must restore original nature

thinking_modes_v6_phase20.definition_zh: 心外无物，心外无事，心外无理。事物的意义和价值只有在心的观照下才得以显现。岩中花树之喻：'你未看此花时，此花与汝心同归于寂；你来看此花时，则此花颜色一时明白起来。'此法强调主体性与客观世界的不可分割，事物的存在意义由心赋予。
thinking_modes_v6_phase20.definition_en: Nothing exists outside the mind; no affairs exist outside the mind; no principle exists outside the mind. The meaning and value of things only manifest under the illumination of the mind. The metaphor of flowers in the rock: 'When you have not yet looked at this flower, the flower and your mind return to silence together; when you come to look at this flower, its color suddenly becomes clear.' This method emphasizes the inseparability of subjectivity and the objective world; the meaning of things is given by the mind.
process_zh: 体认心是意义赋予的主体
在观照中理解事物与心的关系
不以心为物役，而以心御物
使每一事物在心的观照下各得其位
process_en: Apprehend that mind is the subject giving meaning
Understand the relationship between things and mind through illumination
Do not let mind be enslaved by things, but let mind govern things
Let each thing attain its proper place under the mind's illumination
thinking_modes_v6_phase20.key_quote_zh: 你未看此花时，此花与汝心同归于寂；你来看此花时，则此花颜色一时明白起来。
thinking_modes_v6_phase20.key_quote_en: When you have not yet looked at this flower, the flower and your mind return to silence together; when you come to look at this flower, its color suddenly becomes clear.
representative_cases_zh: 阳明游南镇，友人生疑：'岩中花树'之问，阳明以心外无物作答，显示事物与心的不可分割
阳明说：'我的发萌不息处，就是造化精灵。'——心的活动与宇宙的生生机一体
反例警示：若把心外无物理解为否定客观世界的存在，则会陷入主观唯心主义的极端——阳明强调的是事物的意义和价值在心之观照下才得以显现
representative_cases_en: Wang visited Nan Mountain, and when a friend questioned about the flowers in the rocks, Wang answered with nothing-outside-mind, showing the inseparability of things and mind
Wang said: 'The source of my vibrant growth is the spirit of creation.' — the activity of mind and the vitality of the cosmos are one

Counterexample: reading nothing-outside-mind as denying the existence of the objective world leads to the extreme of subjective idealism — Wang emphasizes that the meaning and value of things only manifest under the illumination of mind

thinking_modes_v6_phase20.definition_zh: 此心光明，亦复何言。这是王阳明临终遗言，也是其一生践履心学的最高境界。心体光明，无所亏欠，无所隐瞒，坦然面对生死，无惧无忧。此法是阳明心学的终极指向，也是其人格魅力的最高体现——良知朗现，光明磊落，无须多言。
thinking_modes_v6_phase20.definition_en: This mind is luminous, what more is there to say? These were Wang Yangming's last words on his deathbed, and the highest realm of his lifelong practice of the School of Mind. The mind's substance is luminous, lacking nothing, hiding nothing, facing death calmly without fear or worry. This is the ultimate direction of Yangming's School of Mind and the highest manifestation of his personal charisma — liangzhi fully manifest, open and upright, requiring no further words.
process_zh: 在念念中保持良知的觉察
去除私欲遮蔽，恢复心体光明
达到无所亏欠、无所隐瞒的境界
坦然面对生死，此心光明
process_en: Maintain liangzhi discernment in each thought
Remove the obscuration of selfish desires, restore the luminosity of the mind's substance
Reach the realm of lacking nothing and hiding nothing
Calmly face life and death, this mind is luminous
thinking_modes_v6_phase20.key_quote_en: This mind is luminous, what more is there to say?
representative_cases_zh: 正德十六年（1529年），阳明病逝于南安，临终遗言'此心光明，亦复何言'，成为千古佳话
阳明一生历经廷杖、贬谪、叛乱、疾病，始终以良知为导，光明磊落，无愧于心
反例警示：若把此心光明理解为自我满足或固执己见，则会陷入道德优越感的陷阱——阳明强调的是经过切实工夫后达到的良知朗现，而非未经修炼的自我感觉良好
representative_cases_en: In 1529, Wang died in Nan'an, his last words 'this mind is luminous, what more is there to say' became a legend for the ages
Throughout his life, facing beatings, exile, rebellion, and illness, Wang always took liangzhi as his guide, open and upright, with nothing to be ashamed of

Counterexample: reading this-mind-is-luminous as self-satisfaction or stubbornness leads to the trap of moral superiority — Wang emphasizes the liangzhi fully manifest after genuine work, not unearned self-satisfaction
modern_applications_en: Searching for the meaning of life
